body.x: Woorisoft will introduce its game-basedcognitive rehabilitation training program Neuro-world at CES 2020, which willbe held in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10. It has won the Innovation Award from CES2020 in software/mobile sector.

The solution combines game technology and artificial intelligence (AI) technology to solve the problems in existing training tools or rehabilitation services. With it, specialized cognitive training can be provided at home.
Also, statistical data analysis function is available to provide personalized and professional cognitive rehabilitation service by cognitive ability evaluation.

The program has been clinically developed by specialists to meet the same standards, evaluations, and training programs. It also increases the voluntary participation by inducing interest with games that provide goals, achievements, and awards, so it is expected to receive great reviews from children and the elderly with cognitive disabilities.

The company official said, "We arecollaborating with domestic and foreign companies and hospitals fordemonstrations and clinical results from the children and the elderly, and weare going to sell this solution not only in Korea, but in Asia and the NorthAmerican regions. We are aiming to sell global products through the earlydetection of cognitive disabilities and personalized training tools."
